item.title: 'Ya taba yin fashi a banki': Baban Chinedu ya fallasa Fasto Dachomo
item.description: Malam Yusuf Haruna Baban Chinedu ya zargi Fasto Ezekiel Dachomo da kasancewa tsohon ɗan fashi, yana cewa ya ƙirƙiri labarin haduwarsa da Yesu bayan harin banki.

item.title: 'Kyauta ce mai girma ƙwarai': Trump ya yaba wa shugabannin Iran kan abin alheri
item.description: Shugaba Donald Trump na Amurka ya ce Iran ta ba Amurka “kyauta mai daraja sosai” da ta shafi mai da gas da mashigar Strait of Hormuz yayin da ake ci gaba da yaki.

item.title: Tinubu ya cimma matsaya da Tarayyar Turai, za a karfafa tsaro a Najeriya
item.description: Tarayyar Turai (EU) da Najeriya sun amince su faɗaɗa haɗin gwiwa kan hakar ma'adanai, tsaro, da kasuwanci yayin da ake fama da yaki a Gabas ta Tsakiya.

item.title: 'Akwai hujjoji':Ukraine ta zargi Rasha da ba Iran bayanan sirri a yakin Isra'ila
item.description: Shugaban Ukraine, Volodymyr Zelenskiy ya ce kasarsa ta samu hujja karara cewa Rasha na bai wa Iran bayanan sirri, lamarin da zai kara tsawaita rikicin.

item.title: Makami mai linzami da Iran ta harba ya sauka Tel Aviv, mutane da dama sun mutu
item.description: Harin makami mai linzami da Iran ta kai Tel Aviv a ranar 24 ga Maris ya kashe aƙalla mutane 16, tare da ruguza gine-gine da jikkata wasu da dama.

item.title: Yakin Iran zai raba alakar Amurka da Turai, Trump na barazanar barin NATO
item.description: Shugaban Amurka, Donald Trumo ya fara barazanar fita daga kungiyar NATO da aka kafa a 1949. Ya ce za su fita daga kungiyar saboda rashin shiga yakin Iran.

item.title: Bayan Iran ta ragargaji Isra'ila, an samu karin mutanen da suka mutu zuwa 14
item.description: A labarin nan, za a ji cewa rahotanni sun tabbatar da yadda ake samun karuwar rasa rayuka yayin da makaman da Iran ke harba wa ke yi wa Isra'ila illa.

item.title: 'Ba za mu iya kawo Kano babu Kwankwaso ba': Jigon APC, Alwan Hassan
item.description: Wani jigo a jam'iyyar APC mai mulki a Najeriya, Alwan Hassan ya bayyana damuwa game da asarar da za su yi bayan sauya shekar Rabiu Kwankwaso zuwa ADC.

item.title: Rushewar karfin adawa da abubuwa 2 da za su faru idan ADC ta hana Obi tikiti
item.description: Wani rahoto ya nuna cewa rashin bai wa Peter Obi tikitin takarar shugaban ƙasa a jam'iyyar ADC na iya tarwatsa 'Obidients' da rage wa hamayya ƙarfi a zaɓen 2027.

item.title: Ministocin tsaro sun ziyarci Borno, an gana da sojojin da ke yaki da yan ta'adda
item.description: A labarin nan, za a ji cewa Ministocin tsaron Najeriya, Christopher Musa da Bello Matawalle sun ziyarci jihar Borno bayan munanan hare-hare a kwanakin baya.

item.title: An daure wanda ya shiga har daki ya tafkawa matar Sarki Sanusi II kazamar sata
item.description: An gurfanar da mai tuka motar matar Sarki Muhammadu Sanusi II da wasu mutane biyu bayan zarginsu da laifin shiga dakin matar Sarki su tafka kazamar sata.

item.title: Kotu ta dage sauraron bukatar El-Rufa'i zuwa 14 ga watan Afrilu
item.description: A labarin nan, za a ji cewa tsohon gwamnan Kaduna Nasir El-Rufa'i zai kammala sanin makaomarsa bayan ya nemu kotu ta ba shi beli a shari'a da ICPC.

item.title: "Tinubu ba zai iya maida Kano jam'iyya 1 ba"; Salihu Tanko Yakasai ya yi bayani
item.description: Tsohon dan takarar gwamnan jihar Kano a zaben 2023, Salihu Tanko Yakasai, ya yi magana kan siyasar Kano. Ya ce Tinubu ba zai iya yin abin da ya yi a Legas ba.

item.title: Taron APC: Mota ta kade hadimin gwamnan Kebbi da kansiloli 2, sun rasa rayukansu
item.description: Rahotanni sun tabbatar da mutuwar daya daga cikin hadiman Gwamna Nasir Idris Kauran Gwandu da wasu kansiloli biyu a hanyarsu ta zuwa filin taron APC a Abuja.

item.title: Isra'ila ta harba makamai 100 da jirage zuwa Isra'ila, za a ga ruwan bama bamai
item.description: Rundunar IRGC ta kasar Iran ta ƙaddamar da gagarumin harin ramuwar gayya da makamai sama da 300 kan sansanonin sojin Amurka da Isra'ila a yau Laraba.
